register.name: M0_DWT_CTRL
register.comment: Defines the number of comparators implemented.

register.name: M0_DWT_PCSR
register.comment: Samples the current value of the program counter.

register.name: M0_DWT_COMP0
register.comment: Provides a reference value for use by comparator 0.

register.name: M0_DWT_MASK0
register.comment:
Provides the size of the ignore mask applied to the access address range matching by comparator 0.
The size of the ignore mask applied to address range matching. See The DWT comparators on
page C1-341 for the usage model.
The mask range is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED. Writing all ones to this field and reading it back
can be used to determine the maximum mask size supported.
